tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa dri ma med pa'i rgyan bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ rang bzhin dri med blo gros glo bur gyi// dri mas bsgribs pa gsal bar mdzad pa yi// dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro grangs med stong phrag bdun cu gnyis// sdud byed sum cu bdun nam sum cu gnyis// de dag rang bzhin lha mo bco lnga'i gtso// gnyis med bzhugs la dang bas bstod par bgyi// sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bdud 'dral cha dang bcas// snying gi dbus gnas gtsug tor mchog tu thim// 'phags pa'i lam lnga drug pa'i cha yi dngos// rdo rje 'dzin sa bcu gsum par phyag 'tshal// dbus nas g.yas g.yon rgyab kyi cha la bzhugs// kun 'dar ro rkyang bdud 'dral aḥdang bcas// khu khrag dri chen dri chu mi rtog skyed// 'phags pa'i lam gsum byang chub la phyag 'tshal// gnas bzhi dbu mar stong las bcu gnyis pa// nye ba'i thung gcod ye shes chen po ste// spang bya kun spangs thob bya kun rdzogs pa// 'khor lo'i dbus na bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// rna ba zhe sdang rnam shes phung po sbyang*// sems dag chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// spros bral a las byung ba'i gnyis med mchog /rdo rje bdag med ma dpal phyag 'tshal bstod// pullīr mi phyed so dang sen mo'i khams// 'bar 'dzin phra gzugs skra dang spu 'bab cing*// gzugs phung gti mug mig sbyong ā las byung*// 'khor lo'i shar gnas rdo rje mar phyag 'tshal// uryan rtse ma lpags pa dri ma skyed// arbur g.yon pa ma ste sha 'bab cing*// tshor ba ser sna sna sbyong i las byung*// lho phyogs gsang ba'i dkar mor bdag phyag 'tshal// spyi bo spyi gtsug rna ba ltag par bzhugs// lus dang tshor ba chos dang sems kyi dngos// rlung dang byang chub sems rnams dbu mar thim// gnas te rab dga'i sa la bdag phyag 'tshal// go dā wa rīr thung du chu rgyus 'bab// ra mer rus sbal skyes ma rus phreng skyed// 'du shes 'dod chags lce sbyong āṃ las byung*// chu bdag chu yi rnal 'byor mar phyag 'tshal// de wī ko ṭar sgom ma mkhal ma skyed// mā lar dbang ma snying 'bab 'du byed dang*// phrag dog lus sbyong u skyes yang dag spang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gnyis pa'i sa la bstod// kā ma rū par skyon ma mig 'bab cing*// o trer mjug ma mkhris 'bab sa yi khams// ū skyes pukka sīs sbyong rdzu 'phrul gnyis// byang shar 'od byed zhing la bdag phyag 'tshal// tri sha ku ner ma mo glo ba 'bab// ko sal mtshan mo rgyu 'bab chu yi khams// ṛ skyes sha ba ris sbyong rdzu 'phrul gnyis// shar lho nye zhing 'od 'phror phyag 'tshal lo// ka liṃ gar ni bsil sbyin chu rgyus 'bab// lambār tsha ba lto ba 'bab ma me// ṝ skyes tsaṇḍā līs sbyong dbang po gnyis// lho nub tshando sbyang dkar bdag phyag 'tshal// kāñtsir gzhol ma snying 'bab kha ba'i rir// tsha ma rus pa'i khams 'bab rlung gi khams// l̥ skyes g.yung mos sbyong zhing dbang po gnyis// nub byang mngon gyur nye ba'i tshandor bstod// pre tar shin tu gzugs can bad kan 'bab// khyim gyi lhar ni spyi ma rnag 'bab gzugs// l̥̄ skyes gau rīs sbyong mdzad dbang po stobs// shar phyogs 'du ba ring du song bar bstod// sau rāṣṭar ni rgyu sbyin khrag 'bab cing*// gser gling sbyor bral rngul 'bab sgra yi khams// e skyes tsau rīs sbyong mdzad stobs gnyis lhor// mi g.yo nye ba'i 'du bar bdag phyag 'tshal// na ga rar ni sdug gu tshil bu 'bab// sindhur grub ma mchi 'bab sna yi yul// ai skyes be tā līs sbyong stobs gnyis nub// dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal// ma ror 'tshed mas mchil ma 'bab pa 'dzin// ku lur yid bzangs snabs 'bab lce yi yul// o skyes ghasma rīs sbyong byang chub gnyis// nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin la 'dud// sum skor 'dod ma reg bya sa spyod sbyong*// au skyes byang chub lam gnyis la btud nas// khyim ma gtum mo chos dbyings mkha' spyod sbyong*// am̐ skyes byang chub lam gnyis la phyag 'tshal// 'di bzhi snying ga'i 'dab brgyad lte ba yi// mtshams na rlung dang bdud rtsi lnga 'dres 'bab// 'di rnams dbu mar thim las 'thung gcod de// dpe med ye shes bcu gcig par phyag 'tshal// kun kyang chos dbyings ngo bos nag por bzhugs// mi gnas mya ngan 'das tshul phyed krung ste// skyon drug gri gug gis bcad bdag med mgo

/gzung 'dzin spangs dang rgyal ba lnga yis brgyan// gdug mnan bdud bzhi 'joms shing yon tan rgyas// ye shes me yi dbus na bde bar bzhugs// dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro bco lnga yi// zhabs la phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su mchi// de ltar lha dang sa yi rim pa bzhin// gus pas bstod nas slar yang bdag gi yid// spro bas rab drangs 'pho ba'i rim pa bzhin// bstod pa 'di yang rtsom par 'dod par gyur// skyes dang bud med dbye ba yis// g.yas g.yon yar ngo mar ngo yi// tshes gcig la sogs 'pho ba'i gnas// dbang mdzad mkha' 'gror bstod par bgyi// tshes gcig lug gi 'pho ba la// mi phyed gtum mo mthe bong gnyis// dga' ba'i dga' ba yi ge a// mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khyu mchog 'pho ba'i tshes gnyis la// phra gzugs khyim ma byin pa gnyis// dga' ba'i mchog dga' yi ge ā// sa spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshes gsum 'khrig pa'i nyi ma ste// brtse ba ma dang 'dod ma ni// brla gnyis dga' ba'i dga' bral i// ghasma rī la phyag 'tshal lo// bzhi pa karka ṭa yi tshes// g.yon pa ma dang sum skor ma// gsang gnas dga' ba'i lhan skyes ī// be tā lī la gus pas 'dud// lnga pa seng ge'i 'pho ba ste// thung ngu yid bzangs lte bar bzhugs// u ste mchog dga'i dga' ba nyid// tsau rī la yang bdag phyag 'tshal// bu mo'i 'pho ba tshes drug la// rus sbal skyes dang 'tshed ma ni// snying gar ū ste mchog dga'i mchog /gau rī la ni gus par 'dud// tshes bdun srang gi 'pho ba ste// sgom ma grub ma nu ma gnyis// mchog dga'i dga' bral yi ge ṛ// g.yung mo la yang bdag phyag 'tshal// sdig pa'i 'pho ba tshes brgyad la// dbang ma sdug gu lkog mar gnas// mchog dga'i lhan skyes yi ge ṝ// tsaṇḍā lī la bdag phyag 'tshal// gzhu yi 'pho ba tshes dgu ste// skyon ma sbyor bral lag mthil gnyis// dga' bral dga' ba'i yi ge l̥// sha wa rī la bdag phyag 'tshal// tshes bcu chu srin 'pho ba la// mjug ma rgyu sbyin mchu gnyis la// dga' bral mchog dga' l̥̄ yi dbyibs// pukka sī la bdag phyag 'tshal// bum pa'i 'pho ba bcu gcig la// ma mo spyi ma mkhur tshos gnyis// dga' bral dga' bral yi ge e// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpal 'dud// bcu gnyis nya yi 'pho ba ste// mtshan mo shin tu gzugs can ai// mig gnyis dga' bral lhan skyes te// chu yi rnal 'byor ma dpal 'dud// zla ba gzas zin bcu gsum pa// bsil sbyin rangs ma rna ba gnyis// lhan skyes dga' ba'i yi ge o// nang gi dkar mor bdag phyag 'tshal// nyi ma gzas zin bcu bzhi pa// tsha ba mo dang gzhol ma au// lhan skyes mchog dga' klad pa gnyis// rdo rje ma dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// thig le 'gog pa bco lnga yi// nyin par ro ma rkyang ma ste// spyi gtsug rna ba g.yas g.yon la// lhan skyes dga' bral yi ge aṃ// mtshan mo nam mkha' 'gog pa ste// lhan skyes lhan skyes spyi gtsug na'o// dkar po'i mtshan mo kun 'dar aḥ

/rtsa gsum bdag med ma dpal 'dud// spyi gtsug aḥste kun 'dar cha// tsheg drag can gnyis hūm̐ gi dngos// nag po'i mtshan mo bdud 'dral khyab// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// 'pho ba gnyis dang rtsa bzhi dang*// tshes dang lhan skyes yi ge gcig /gnas gcig na ni gnyis med bzhugs// shes rab thabs la bdag phyag 'tshal// g.yas g.yon gzung 'dzin rtsa ste kun 'dar mas// sngon du aḥblangs cung zad rags pas na// sum cu gcig lhag thabs rnams shes rab kyis// sbyangs pas sbyong byed bcu drug pa spangs so// gal te sbyang gzhi lhag ma gnas she na// lhan skyes lhan skyes aḥste bdud 'dral ma// stong la stong bzhag sbyong zhes don med de// shes rab thabs dag he ru ka yi dngos// des na rdo rje theg pa'i zab don kun// thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa la// kho bo'i sems ni mchog tu dad pa yis// rdo rje theg la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rgyas par rab tu bstod pa ni// lan gnyis brjod pas sems spro nas// slar yang bsdus te bstod pa ni// 'di yang brjod par 'dod par 'gyur// phung po khams dang skye mched sbyong ba smin byed dang bcas bskyed pa'i phyogs la lha mo bco lnga'i dngos// gtso bo sum cu gnyis dang sbas pa lnga ni byang chub phyogs yin phra mo rnams dang rtsa yig bcas// rtsa ba'i khams lnga 'phel bas dpag med rlung dang bcas pa zab mo gsum ste kun kyang bco lnga'i dngos// 'pho ba ā li dga' ba stong nyid sa mchog rnams kyang lha mo nyid de gnyis med la phyag 'tshal// bstod pas mgrin pa brgyan pa ni// 'dod pas yun ring rab gdungs pa// rin chen phreng ba dri ma med// brgyus pa 'dis yid phrogs shig go /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug la// mchog tu dad pas bstod pa las// byung ba grags pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun thar pa'i rgyal mtshan shog /lha mo bco lngar bstod pa'i gzhung*// dri ma med pa zhes bya ba// dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis// dpal ldan sa skyar 'bad de bris// dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bcas pa'i lha mo bco lnga la bstod pa rgyud gsum la 'jug pa rin po che'i phreng ba dri ma med pa zhes bya ba shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so//

//nyes pa rnams bla ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol zhing*/ de las byung ba'i dge ba sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob par gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig 'di la tsheg bar dgu pa nyer bdun/ bdun pa nyer gnyis/ nyer gcig pa gcig bsdoms pas lnga bcu'o// // ༄༅// bdag med bstod pa'i bsdus don bzhugs// ༄༅// 'di la don gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gnyis te/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// bar pa la gnyis te/ rgyas par bstod pa dang*/ bsdus te bstod pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sa dang lha'i rim pa bzhin bstod pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba'i sgo nas bstod pa'o// spyi don bzhi pa byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba'i sgo nas bstod pa la bzhi ste/ rtsom pa'i rgyu dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ don dngos dang*/ dag byed lha mo bcu drug pa ma bshad pa'i 'thad pa'o// 'thad pa de la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ rtsod pa spang ba'o// bsdus te bstod pa la gnyis te/ rtsom pa'i rgyu dang*/ don dngos so// mjug la gnyis te/ bstan bcos mthar phyin pas rtsom pa po'i thugs tshim pa dang*/ brtsams pa'i dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
